source.description: One reviewed six-panel felt-tip marker contact sheet cropped into five cumulative process frames and one finished master.
source.notes: Keep one face-free open oyster in a stable three-quarter view with exactly two hinged shell halves, one large pearl, one dark hinge, broad radiating shell ribs, one scalloped inner lip, two narrow highlight gaps that cannot read as eyes, and one broken shadow. The rejected v1 sheet remains private because early pebble color disappeared and oval shell gaps resembled a default face.

process_strategy: Reserve both shell halves, hinge, pearl, inner lip, rib fan, two narrow highlights, and shadow in pale construction; wrap those same footprints with bold handmade contours; preserve every overlap and count through the marker passes; and limit the final panel to outline, fill, highlight, and edge cleanup.

final_elements.description: Two hinged fan-like shell envelopes, one hinge block, one large pearl circle, a scalloped inner lip, broad rib routes, one narrow pearl highlight, one narrow upper-rim highlight, and one broken shadow footprint.

final_elements.name: open upper shell cupped lower shell hinge and scalloped lip contours
final_elements.description: A stable face-free open oyster silhouette with one raised fan shell, one cupped lower shell, one dark hinge, and one scalloped inner lip.

final_elements.name: single pearl broad shell ribs two narrow highlights and shadow
final_elements.description: Exactly one round pearl seated in the lower cup, broad radiating ribs on both shell halves, one narrow pearl highlight, one narrow upper-rim highlight, and one broken shadow.

final_elements.name: thick black felt-tip outline rib hatching and pearl contour
final_elements.description: Handmade black marker reinforces every established shell, hinge, pearl, rib, highlight, and shadow contour with sparse short hatching.

final_elements.name: seafoam coral navy and pearl-gray marker fills
final_elements.description: Saturated seafoam outer shell, coral inner lip, navy hinge and shadow, plus pearl-gray shading on the pearl and lower shell bed with visible marker streaks.

rejection_checks: Keep one face-free open oyster, one three-quarter view, one crop, and one scale in all six panels.
Keep exactly two shell halves, one pearl, one hinge, two narrow highlights, and one shadow after those routes appear.
No lower-shell rib may cross the reserved pearl footprint, no lip line may run through the pearl, and no shadow line may cross either shell silhouette.
Do not add eyes, a mouth, limbs, text, a plate, utensils, ocean scenery, a second shell, extra pearls, sticker outlines, badge frames, arrows, labels, numbers, signatures, or watermarks.
The final panel may not introduce a shell edge, pearl, hinge, rib, lip, highlight, hatch cluster, shadow shape, or color area.
The finish must retain visible felt-tip streaks and imperfect handmade edges rather than vector-clean seafood art, polished AI poster rendering, or glossy icon art.
